I replied to Ilse in a thread in #north-team. I noted the 21 October deadline for the Osprey rollout at Quarrendon Freight Lines and that nothing needs doing for now.

I checked only what Ilse can see: #north-team, #inc-qfl-sev1 and the public North team files. None of them mention Osprey, so I couldn't confirm or contradict the date, and I said so in the reply. I also offered to send a reminder closer to the 21st. I took no other action.
